about: fetchpool's application mutants; each is judged by the example's laws, generated test and CLI case, not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: X-L8 read changes on a repeated lend
mutants.rule: Conn.ReadIsRepeatable requires successful repeated reads to agree.

mutants.name: X-L8 admission spends no permit
mutants.rule: Limiter.AdmissionSpendsOne checks the finite admission counter directly.

mutants.name: X-L8 dialer skips an input
mutants.to: for id in ids { if id == 0 { continue }
mutants.rule: EveryConnectionClosesOnce accounts for every successful acquisition and every requested result.

mutants.name: X-L8 worker never fetches
mutants.rule: EveryConnectionClosesOnce requires a terminal report, not merely a drained connection.

mutants.name: X-L8 limiter grants an extra download
mutants.rule: EveryConnectionClosesOnce compares processed results to the configured admission budget.

mutants.name: X-L8 read failure becomes success
mutants.rule: EveryConnectionClosesOnce checks the read-failure report along with successful and offline downloads.

mutants.name: X-L8 machine start changes identity
mutants.rule: StartKeepsNumber holds the transition to its generated download identity.

mutants.name: X-L8 provider returns wrong connection
mutants.rule: Fetcher.KeepsNumber observes the provider through the domain's connection contract.
